caption: The Shopify dialog Install app for Wholesale Gorilla: a warning that Wholesale Gorilla does not support market-driven shipping, and the access it asks for: View customer data, View staff and contributor data and View and edit store data, with Cancel and Install. The organization name in the settings menu is covered; the account details at the bottom left and the store header were already covered by the tester.

The plan screen that Wholesale Gorilla opens on after the install: 21-day FREE trial for all plans, Lite $34.95 a month, Advanced $69.95 a month (popular) and Premium $149.95 a month. The store name at the bottom left is covered.

The Shopify screen Approve subscription for Wholesale Gorilla, plan Lite: the line You will not be billed for this test charge, $34,95 USD every 30 days, a 21-day free trial ending on 8 Dec, total $34,95 due 8 Dec, and the row Add payment method. Nothing was approved. The store name at the bottom left is covered.
